card.name: Space before a size measurement number
card.fires_on: The space or small word right before a number giving the girth, width or span of a large object such as a tree, gorge or building. The next word is expected to be a size figure, not a diameter word.

modes.label: Girth or width of trees
modes.description: The gap before a number after 'girth of', 'has a' or 'span' when describing big trees.

modes.label: Other large object sizes
modes.description: The gap before a number giving the width or size of engines, gorges or monuments.
modes.example: The foundation of the pagoda alone is approximately<< >>50 metres or 165

card.writes: It suppresses diameter and thickness words, so the model goes straight to a number instead.
card.plain: It fires just before a size figure for something big, like a tree's girth, where a number is due rather than the word diameter.
